title: JSFL: setLayerProperty/getLayerProperty on wrong object and missing layerIndex param
description:
In Flash 8 JSFL, setLayerProperty(layerIndex, property, value) and getLayerProperty(layerIndex, property) are methods on the Timeline object (not Document), and take a layerIndex as the first parameter.

Current implementation (packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts):
- These methods are on JsflDocument (interface at line 1894/1899, implementation at lines 3708/3740)
- Signature is (property, value) — no layerIndex
- Always operates on state.currentLayerIndex rather than an explicit layer index

Correct Flash 8 JSFL API:
  var tl = fl.getDocumentDOM().getTimeline();
  tl.setLayerProperty(0, 'layerType', 'guide');  // first param is layer index
  var t = tl.getLayerProperty(0, 'layerType');

Fix needed:
1. Add setLayerProperty(layerIndex, property, value) and getLayerProperty(layerIndex, property) to JsflTimeline interface
2. Implement them in makeTimelineProxy() using the explicit layerIndex
3. Can keep the doc-level stubs as aliases for backward compat but they are non-standard

No existing callers — this is an API surface bug that would break any JSFL script using the standard signature.
